title: 第23章 职业者考核第24章 呼吸法
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条

游侠公会的室外靶场上，秋日的寒风带着几分萧瑟。
“第一组，上前！”
随着考官一声令下，五名考生并排站在了白线之后。维克多就在其中，他紧了紧手中的黑角弓，目光扫过远处那条长达百米的滑轨。
考核内容是移动靶射击。
并没有多少准备时间，伴随着机括的搅动声，二十个圆盘靶子顺着滑轨从两边高速移动起来，速度几乎快赶上奔马。
“嗖！嗖！嗖！”
【青岚·游击弓术】——发动。
淡青色的微风在他指尖缠绕，顺着弓弦蔓延至箭羽。普通的射手在应对移动靶时，需要计算提前量，考虑风向、风力等因素。
维克多只需要让风，成为箭的向导。
崩！
黑角弓发出一声低沉的闷响。箭矢离弦而去，在空中划出一道几乎看不清的弧线。这并非直线，而是一条被风精细修正过的微弧。就在靶子即将滑过中点的瞬间，箭矢如同长了眼睛一般，“笃”地一声，稳稳扎在了靶心红圈之内。
四箭，全中。
整个过程维克多甚至没有移动半步，那种举重若轻的姿态，让他身边那个射空了箭袋的半精灵看得目瞪口呆。
“36号，合格。”
“33号，合格。”
“其他淘汰，立刻离开考场。”
考官冷漠的声音响起，维克多松了口气，收起弓，在几道羡慕嫉妒的目光中，走向了考场深处的那扇沉重铁门。
真正的考验，现在才开始。
……

“第二阶段，实战模拟通道。”
铁门后，是一个巨大的室内穹顶建筑，仿佛一只巨兽的腹腔。一条蜿蜒的主干道向深处延伸，两侧布满了复杂的炼金管道和符文法阵。
“听好了，”那个红发女考官站在高台上，指着下方的通道，“从这里跑到终点，限时五分钟。路面上亮起光标的地方必须踩点，踩点后会触发靶位。击中所有攻击靶，误伤干扰靶超过两次，直接出局。”
她顿了顿，露出一抹意味深长的笑容：“祝各位未来的游侠好运~”
计时开始的蜂鸣声骤然响起。
维克多没有丝毫犹豫，脚下青光一闪，游击弓术的青岚风息凝聚于脚下。
他就像一片被狂风卷起的落叶，身体几乎贴着地面滑行而出，瞬间冲过了起跑线。
刚跑出不到五十米，原本平静的通道内突然狂风大作！
呜——！
这不是自然的风，而是由两侧巨大的风箱和风元素法阵制造的乱流。狂暴的气流吹得人睁不开眼，连站稳都成问题，更别提射箭了。
前方地面上的光标亮起，维克多刚一脚踩上去，三个红色的攻击靶标就从侧面的墙壁上弹了出来。与此同时，强烈的侧风像是要把箭矢直接吹回他脸上。
“在这种环境下射击？”
维克多眼神一凝。普通的箭术在离弦的瞬间就会被吹歪。
【器鸣共频】
这种奇妙的被动状态让他清晰地感受到了弓弦在狂风中的每一丝震颤，甚至能通过弓身感知到气流的强弱变化。
既然风要阻挡我，那就切开它。
维克多手指轻捻，【青岚】的风息不再是助推，而是化作锋利的螺旋缠绕在箭杆之上。

At the outdoor shooting range of the Ranger Guild, the cold autumn wind was a bit desolate.
"First group, step forward!"
Following the examiner's order, the five candidates stood side by side behind the white line. Victor was among them. He tightened the black-horned bow in his hand and glanced at the hundred-meter-long slide rail in the distance.
The assessment content is moving target shooting.
There was not much preparation time. With the churning sound of the machine, twenty disc targets moved along the slide rails from both sides at high speed, almost as fast as a galloping horse.
"Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!"
[Qinglan·Guerrilla Archery]——Activate.
The light cyan breeze entwined around his fingertips and spread along the bowstring to the arrow feathers. When ordinary shooters deal with moving targets, they need to calculate the lead time and consider factors such as wind direction and wind strength.
Victor just needs to let the wind be the guide for the arrow.
collapse!
The black-horned bow made a low muffled sound. The arrow left the string and drew an almost invisible arc in the air. This is not a straight line, but a slight arc finely modified by the wind. Just when the target was about to slide past the midpoint, the arrow seemed to have eyes. With a "click" sound, it stabbed firmly into the red circle of the bull's eye.
Four arrows, all hits.
During the whole process, Victor didn't even move a step. His light-weight posture made the half-elf next to him, who had empty his quiver, stunned.
"No. 36, passed."
"No. 33, passed."
"Other candidates will be eliminated and leave the examination room immediately."
The examiner's cold voice sounded, and Victor breathed a sigh of relief, put away his bow, and walked toward the heavy iron door deep in the examination room amid a few envious and jealous eyes.
The real test begins now.
…
"The second stage is the actual combat simulation channel."
Behind the iron gate is a huge indoor dome building, like the belly of a giant beast. A winding main road extends deep into the depths, with complex alchemy pipelines and runic arrays lined on both sides.
"Listen up," the red-haired female examiner stood on the high platform, pointing to the passage below, "Run from here to the finish line, the time limit is five minutes. You must step on the spot where the cursor lights up on the road, and the target will be triggered after you step on it. If you hit all attack targets, accidentally damage the interference target more than twice, you will be eliminated directly."
She paused and showed a meaningful smile: "I wish all future rangers good luck~"
The beep to start the timer suddenly sounded.
Victor didn't hesitate at all. A flash of green light flashed under his feet, and the Qinglan wind energy of guerrilla archery condensed under his feet.
He was like a fallen leaf blown up by the strong wind. His body almost slid out of the ground and he crossed the starting line in an instant.
Just after running less than fifty meters, a strong wind suddenly blew up in the originally calm passage!
Woo——!
This is not a natural wind, but a turbulence created by the huge bellows and wind elemental formations on both sides. The violent air flow made it difficult to keep one's eyes open, making it difficult to stand still, let alone shoot an arrow.
The cursor on the ground in front lit up, and as soon as Victor stepped on it, three red attack targets popped out of the side wall. At the same time, a strong crosswind seemed to blow the arrow right back into his face.
"Shooting in this environment?"
Victor's eyes narrowed. Ordinary archery will be blown away the moment it leaves the string.
[Resonant frequency of instrument sound]
This wonderful passive state allowed him to clearly feel every vibration of the bow string in the strong wind, and he could even feel the changes in the strength of the airflow through the bow body.
Since the wind wants to stop me, let's cut it.
Victor lightly twisted his fingers, and [Qing Lan]'s wind breath no longer acted as a boost, but turned into a sharp spiral wrapped around the arrow shaft.
